remarks: HEAT & HOT WATER INCLUDED! Affordable and Centrally Located in Norwalk, CT. Just a short walk away from Norwalk Hospital. Character filled 1 bedroom condo with heat and hot water included in price! Great sized bedroom & living room with plenty closet space + attic for storage. Washer/Dryer in near building + assigned parking also for your comfort! This is a 2nd FL apartment with Only 1 other unit in building (ground level)! Natural gas stove, refrigerator/freezer. New vinyl flooring in the kitchen and a nice sized bathroom. New hardwood floors throughout + many windows for natural light. 1 assigned parking and plenty of visitor parking spaces available. Laundry room on premises. Conveniently located near shopping, transportation, SONO, hospital, I-95 connector. Tenants must have good credit, proof of income & references.
